function.name: run_skill_script
function.description: Runs a JavaScript file associated with a skill. Prefer the canonical skill-relative path shown by the skill, such as scripts/search.js; a unique basename such as search.js or search is also accepted.

skillName.description: Exact skill name returned by load_skill, for example ui-ux-pro-max-pp.

scriptName.description: Canonical path relative to the skill root, for example scripts/search.js. A unique basename with or without the .js extension is also accepted.

arguments.description: Arguments passed to the script. Do not place skillName or scriptName inside this object.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
